body.objective: Restore the promised fast coordinator loop on a large sharded programme: overview, streams-view, and programme Git status must return promptly enough for continuous queue monitoring instead of silently consuming a resident coordinator turn.
body.stop_condition: Land deterministic large-programme performance gates such that: (1) `s-f overview --now T` over the current physics planning corpus emits its first complete dashboard within 5 seconds on the reference workstation and remains byte-stable across two runs; (2) `s-f streams-view --now T -o V` completes within 10 seconds and atomically replaces V only after a complete render; (3) `s-f git status` scopes its expensive untracked/worktree scan to the resolved programme workdir by default, or provides and documents an equally safe programme-scope mode, while still reporting the repository HEAD and shared-index staleness; (4) repeated read-only calls reuse a content-addressed fold/index keyed by the work-item and append-only-event inputs rather than reparsing the full corpus when no input changed; (5) one new event invalidates only the affected fold/index portion and is visible immediately; (6) a timeout or corrupt cache fails visibly and never returns a stale dashboard as current; and (7) benchmark fixtures exercise the present physics corpus scale, concurrent append-only event creation, a stale shared Git index, and a large unrelated monorepo outside the programme root.
body.forbid: no hidden wall clock; no mutation, lease acquisition, lifecycle transition, or index rewrite from read-only commands; no silently stale dashboard; no cache key based only on directory mtime; no scanning the entire monorepo's untracked files when the requested truth is programme-scoped; no weakening the HEAD-to-worktree or append-only fold semantics; no special case keyed to this repository name.
notes: Live reproduction on 2026-07-21: `/usr/bin/timeout 15s env SF_PROGRAM=$PWD/planning SF_NO_TITLE=1 s-f overview --now 2026-07-21T02:xx:xxZ` exited 124 after 15 seconds with zero stdout and zero stderr. Two earlier coordinator invocations remained silent beyond 60 seconds and were terminated.

The same session observed `s-f git status` print only its three-line header and then remain silent beyond 60 seconds while scanning the enclosing bp2transformer monorepo. A private HEAD-seeded `git status` restricted to `physics/symplectic-reconstruction` completed in approximately 2.5 seconds and exposed the expected active-team edits.

Compose with science-forge-coordinator-queue-forecasting and science-forge-agent-status-stream-diagnostics, but keep this ticket responsible only for the shared deterministic fold/cache and programme-scoped read-only performance surface. Forecasting and display-name semantics remain owned by their existing requests.
